post_alignment_tests.scope: Source working-tree release overlay after version alignment. No fresh Linux, Windows, installed GUI, scale or full-workspace qualification.

frontend_product_identity.scope: Source package, brand, display label and language-pack target agreement, not installed WebView acceptance.

release_checks.static_checks: Solver/Engine all-target Clippy with warnings denied, Rust formatting and diff whitespace checks passed.
release_checks.language_pack_metadata: 60 canonical packs validated for 3.7.0, Workbench 960/960 and Hub 510/510 indexed keys; translation content unchanged.
release_checks.documentation: 26 HTML book files, manifest, research bootstrap and documentation inventory passed; repeated version synchronization made no changes.
release_checks.desktop_mirrors: Native shared-asset synchronization and independent verification passed; no binary build.
release_checks.installation_integrity: Disk-hygiene and component-integrity checks/self-tests passed, including 11 components and 16 required layout rules.
release_checks.release_catalog: Release-snapshot, version-audit and update-catalog self-tests passed; only 3.7.0 is current.
release_checks.architecture: Module extension standard, topology, matrix and tensor checks/self-tests passed. Thirteen modules, eleven paradigms, zero structural gaps, two maturity gaps, 23 evidence-grade gaps and 18 P0 gaps; qualification remains blocked.
release_checks.project_organization: Source limit 800, documentation limit 2000, tracked debt zero. Pending-file size/path and private-key/token-signature checks found no generated bulk, private config or matching secrets; this is not a full security audit.
release_checks.scope: Source release checks only; no App build/install, CI result, registry publication or public artifact distribution is claimed.

final_complex_range_scope_per_platform.scope: Selected Solver/Engine libraries and harmonic integration targets, not full workspace, installed, Windows or scale acceptance.

verification.report_provenance: Reports retain their original source metadata, working-tree overlay, platform and exclusions. Overlapping suites are not added together; advancing to 3.7.0 does not relabel earlier runs.
known_limits: Original-equation admission is scoped to integrated consumers, not universal coverage or independent physical certification.
Modal physical-publication gaps, conditioning, independent solver correlation and sustained-scale performance remain separate work.
Same-input replay and cancellation checks are not host-power-loss durability or exactly-once recovery.
Native LAN authentication, installed journeys, multi-host Mesh load and cross-language SDK qualification remain open.
Tensor grades are not promoted by this release; qualification remains blocked.
verification.qualification: Source metadata alignment and scoped regressions do not close all readiness gaps or establish installed-platform acceptance.
